writeup: This new Aberlite EDC Gray beard straightener brush (model B550, UPC 045928591667) is $19.99. It is a travel-size heated comb with six heat settings and weighs about 0.45 lb. Storkz has the same B550 Gray in stock at $79.99, Newegg lists it at $97.99, and GoSupps at $124.99, so this is 75% and about $60 below the lowest of those live prices. Woot showed 3+ left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
